Let me check the file once more and try to set up the geospatial tooling so validation can run.

```python
import os, glob, subprocess, sys

print("CWD:", os.getcwd())
hits = sorted(set(glob.glob('**/*.csv', recursive=True)) | set(glob.glob('/**/survey_points*', recursive=False)))
print("survey files:", hits if hits else "NONE")

# try to install pyproj
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "-q", "pyproj"],
                   capture_output=True, text=True)
print("pip returncode:", r.returncode)
print("pip stderr (tail):", (r.stderr or "")[-500:])
```
